title: Learning consequences coordinate cap
statement: Let $t>0$ be a rational influence bound and let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter. The learning consequences coordinate cap is the ceiling of $2t$ divided by the learning consequences threshold for $t$ and $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the threshold, preventing a more explicit account of this quantity.
